+class EventCheckInsController < ApplicationController
+  prepend_before_action :remember_check_in, only: :show
+  before_action :set_event
+
+  def show
+    @attendance = current_member.attendances.find_by(event: @event)
+  end
+
+  def create
+    attendance = EventCheckIn.call(member: current_member, event: @event,
+      latitude: params[:latitude], longitude: params[:longitude])
+    redirect_to event_check_in_path(@event), status: :see_other,
+      notice: "You're marked present! #{helpers.pluralize(attendance.points_awarded, 'point')} added to your total."
+  rescue EventCheckIn::Rejected => error
+    @check_in_error = error.message
+    @attendance = current_member.attendances.find_by(event: @event)
+    render :show, status: :unprocessable_entity
+  rescue ActiveRecord::ActiveRecordError => error
+    Rails.logger.error("Check-in failed for event #{@event.id}: #{error.class}")
+    @check_in_error = "Check-in couldn't be saved. Please try again."
+    render :show, status: :service_unavailable
+  end
+
+  private
+
+  def remember_check_in
+    store_location_for(:member, request.fullpath) unless member_signed_in?
+  end
+
+  def set_event
+    @event = Event.find(params[:event_id])
+  end
+end

+import { Controller } from "@hotwired/stimulus"
+
+export default class extends Controller {
+  static targets = ["latitude", "longitude", "button", "status"]
+
+  submit(event) {
+    event.preventDefault()
+    if (this.buttonTarget.disabled) return
+    if (!window.isSecureContext || !navigator.geolocation) {
+      this.statusTarget.textContent = "Location is unavailable. Open this page over HTTPS (or localhost for development)."
+      return
+    }
+    this.buttonTarget.disabled = true
+    this.statusTarget.textContent = "Finding your location…"
+    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
+      ({ coords }) => {
+        if (!this.element.isConnected) return
+        this.latitudeTarget.value = coords.latitude
+        this.longitudeTarget.value = coords.longitude
+        this.statusTarget.textContent = "Checking you in…"
+        HTMLFormElement.prototype.submit.call(this.element)
+      },
+      (error) => {
+        if (!this.element.isConnected) return
+        this.buttonTarget.disabled = false
+        this.statusTarget.textContent = error.code === 1
+          ? "Location permission was denied. Allow location access in your browser, then try again."
+          : "Couldn't find your location. Move somewhere with a better signal and try again."
+      },
+      { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 15000, maximumAge: 0 }
+    )
+  }
+}

+import { Controller } from "@hotwired/stimulus"
+
+export default class extends Controller {
+  static targets = ["latitude", "longitude", "button", "status"]
+
+  locate() {
+    if (this.buttonTarget.disabled) return
+    if (!window.isSecureContext || !navigator.geolocation) {
+      this.statusTarget.textContent = "Location is unavailable. Enter the venue coordinates manually."
+      return
+    }
+    this.buttonTarget.disabled = true
+    this.statusTarget.textContent = "Finding your location…"
+    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
+      ({ coords }) => {
+        if (!this.element.isConnected) return
+        this.latitudeTarget.value = coords.latitude.toFixed(6)
+        this.longitudeTarget.value = coords.longitude.toFixed(6)
+        this.buttonTarget.disabled = false
+        this.statusTarget.textContent = "Location filled in. Save the event to apply it."
+      },
+      () => {
+        if (!this.element.isConnected) return
+        this.buttonTarget.disabled = false
+        this.statusTarget.textContent = "Couldn't get your location. Allow location access and retry, or enter coordinates manually."
+      },
+      { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 15000, maximumAge: 0 }
+    )
+  }
+}

+class EventCheckIn
+  class Rejected < StandardError; end
+
+  EARTH_RADIUS_METERS = 6_371_000.0
+
+  def self.call(member:, event:, latitude:, longitude:)
+    new.call(member: member, event: event, latitude: latitude, longitude: longitude)
+  end
+
+  def call(member:, event:, latitude:, longitude:)
+    raise Rejected, "Please sign in before checking in." unless member&.persisted?
+
+    # Serializing check-ins for this member protects both duplicate scans and
+    # simultaneous point awards from different events.
+    member.with_lock do
+      attendance = Attendance.find_or_initialize_by(member: member, event: event)
+      raise Rejected, "You have already checked in to this event." if attendance.checked_in_at?
+
+      raise Rejected, "Check-in is not configured for this event yet." unless event.check_in_configured?
+
+      lat = coordinate(latitude, -90..90)
+      lon = coordinate(longitude, -180..180)
+      if distance_meters(event.latitude.to_f, event.longitude.to_f, lat, lon) > event.check_in_radius_meters
+        raise Rejected, "You are not nearby. Move closer to the event and try again."
+      end
+
+      attendance.update!(checked_in_at: Time.current, points_awarded: event.point_value)
+      member.update!(points: member.points.to_i + attendance.points_awarded)
+      attendance
+    end
+  end
+
+  private
+
+  def coordinate(value, range)
+    number = Float(value)
+    raise ArgumentError unless number.finite? && range.cover?(number)
+
+    number
+  rescue ArgumentError, TypeError
+    raise Rejected, "A valid location is required. Allow location access and try again."
+  end
+
+  def distance_meters(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2)
+    radians = Math::PI / 180
+    a = Math.sin((lat2 - lat1) * radians / 2)**2 +
+      Math.cos(lat1 * radians) * Math.cos(lat2 * radians) * Math.sin((lon2 - lon1) * radians / 2)**2
+    2 * EARTH_RADIUS_METERS * Math.asin(Math.sqrt(a.clamp(0.0, 1.0)))
+  end
+end

+require "rails_helper"
+
+RSpec.describe "Event attendance", type: :request do
+  let(:event) { create(:event) }
+  let(:officer) { create(:member, :admin, :profile_completed) }
+
+  it "shows an officer only checked-in members for the selected event" do
+    sign_in officer
+    member = create(:member, first_name: "Alice", last_name: "Nguyen")
+    checked_in_at = Time.utc(2026, 9, 22, 15, 30)
+    create(:attendance, event: event, member: member, checked_in_at: checked_in_at)
+    absent = create(:attendance, event: event)
+    other = create(:attendance, checked_in_at: checked_in_at)
+
+    get event_path(event)
+
+    expect(response).to have_http_status(:ok)
+    expect(response.body).to include("Alice Nguyen", checked_in_at.iso8601, "Check-in time")
+    expect(response.body).not_to include(absent.member.last_name, other.member.last_name)
+  end
+
+  it "shows an empty state and includes new check-ins after refreshing" do
+    sign_in officer
+    get event_path(event)
+    expect(response.body).to include("No attendees yet.")
+
+    member = create(:member, first_name: "New", last_name: "Attendee")
+    create(:attendance, event: event, member: member, checked_in_at: Time.current)
+    get event_path(event)

+require "rails_helper"
+
+RSpec.describe "Concurrent event check-in", type: :model do
+  self.use_transactional_tests = false
+
+  it "records one attendance and one point award when two scans arrive together" do
+    member = create(:member, points: 4)
+    event = create(:event, latitude: 30.6, longitude: -96.3, point_value: 2)
+    ready = Queue.new
+    start = Queue.new
+    workers = 2.times.map do
+      Thread.new do
+        ActiveRecord::Base.connection_pool.with_connection do
+          local_member = Member.find(member.id)
+          local_event = Event.find(event.id)
+          ready << true
+          start.pop
+          begin
+            EventCheckIn.call(member: local_member, event: local_event, latitude: 30.6, longitude: -96.3)
+            :saved
+          rescue EventCheckIn::Rejected
+            :duplicate
+          end
+        end
+      end
+    end
+    2.times { ready.pop }
+    2.times { start << true }
+
+    expect(workers.map(&:value)).to contain_exactly(:saved, :duplicate)
+    expect(Attendance.where(member: member, event: event).count).to eq(1)
+    expect(member.reload.points).to eq(6)
+  ensure
+    workers&.each(&:join)
+    event&.destroy!
+    member&.destroy!
+  end
+end

+require "rails_helper"
+
+RSpec.describe EventCheckIn do
+  let(:member) { create(:member, points: 4) }
+  let(:event) { create(:event, latitude: 30.6, longitude: -96.3, point_value: 2) }
+
+  def check_in(**overrides)
+    described_class.call(**{ member: member, event: event, latitude: 30.6, longitude: -96.3 }.merge(overrides))
+  end
+
+  it "records a nearby member and awards the event's points" do
+    attendance = check_in(latitude: 30.6001)
+    expect(attendance.checked_in_at).to be_present
+    expect(attendance.points_awarded).to eq(2)
+    expect(member.reload.points).to eq(6)
+  end
+
+  it "rejects a duplicate without changing the original timestamp or awarding points again" do
+    attendance = check_in
+    original_time = attendance.checked_in_at
+    expect { check_in }.to raise_error(EventCheckIn::Rejected, /already checked in/)
+    expect(member.reload.points).to eq(6)
+    expect(attendance.reload.checked_in_at).to eq(original_time)
+    expect(Attendance.where(member: member, event: event).count).to eq(1)
+  end
+
+  it "checks in an existing unconfirmed attendance record" do
+    attendance = create(:attendance, member: member, event: event)
+    expect { check_in }.not_to change(Attendance, :count)
+    expect(attendance.reload.checked_in_at).to be_present
+    expect(member.reload.points).to eq(6)
+  end
+
+  it "rejects distant members without recording attendance or points" do
+    expect { check_in(latitude: 31) }.to raise_error(EventCheckIn::Rejected, /not nearby/)
+    expect(Attendance.where(member: member)).to be_empty
+    expect(member.reload.points).to eq(4)
+  end
+
+  it "requires authentication" do
+    expect { check_in(member: nil) }.to raise_error(EventCheckIn::Rejected, /sign in/)
+  end
+
+  it "rejects events without coordinates" do
+    event.update!(latitude: nil, longitude: nil)
+    expect { check_in }.to raise_error(EventCheckIn::Rejected, /not configured/)
+    expect(member.reload.points).to eq(4)
+  end
+
+  it "rejects missing, malformed, nonfinite, and out-of-range locations" do
+    [ nil, "", "wrong", Float::INFINITY, Float::NAN, 91 ].each do |latitude|
+      expect { check_in(latitude: latitude) }.to raise_error(EventCheckIn::Rejected, /valid location/)
+    end
+    expect { check_in(longitude: -181) }.to raise_error(EventCheckIn::Rejected, /valid location/)
+    expect(Attendance.where(member: member)).to be_empty
+    expect(member.reload.points).to eq(4)
+  end
+
+  it "rolls attendance back if the points update fails" do
+    allow(member).to receive(:update!).and_raise(ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid.new(member))
+    expect { check_in }.to raise_error(ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid)
+    expect(Attendance.where(member: member)).to be_empty
+    expect(member.reload.points).to eq(4)
+  end
+
+  it "awards points separately for different events" do
+    check_in
+    check_in(event: create(:event, latitude: 30.6, longitude: -96.3, point_value: 3))
+    expect(member.reload.points).to eq(9)
+  end
+end
